text:
## Policy Statement  
**FirstUK Bank processes customer personal data only where necessary for banking services, with proper safeguards and customer control.**
name: Chunk 5/36

raw_entities.name: Data Processing and Customer Control Policy
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank's overarching policy governing the processing of customer personal data. The policy establishes that data processing occurs only where necessary for the delivery of banking services, with mandatory safeguards in place and explicit customer control mechanisms. This policy forms the foundation for the bank's data protection compliance framework.
context: FirstUK Bank processes customer personal data only where necessary for banking services
with proper safeguards and customer control

raw_entities.name: Necessity Limitation for Data Processing
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that customer personal data processing by FirstUK Bank must be limited to only those instances where processing is necessary for the delivery of banking services. This provision establishes the principle of data minimisation and purpose limitation.
context: processes customer personal data only where necessary for banking services

raw_entities.name: Data Safeguards Implementation
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that FirstUK Bank must implement and maintain proper safeguards when processing customer personal data. This provision establishes the bank's obligation to protect data through appropriate technical and organisational measures.
context: with proper safeguards and customer control

raw_entities.name: Customer Control Over Personal Data
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that customers must retain meaningful control over their personal data processed by FirstUK Bank. This provision establishes customer rights to direct, consent to, or otherwise govern the use of their data.
context: with proper safeguards and customer control

raw_entities.name: Data Breach
raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorised access to, loss of, or compromise of customer personal data. FirstUK Bank's data processing policy is designed to mitigate this risk through the implementation of proper safeguards.
context: with proper safeguards and customer control

raw_entities.name: Unauthorised Data Processing
raw_entities.description: The risk that customer personal data may be processed for purposes beyond what is necessary for banking services or without appropriate customer consent and control. The policy addresses this through necessity limitation and customer control mechanisms.
context: processes customer personal data only where necessary for banking services
with proper safeguards and customer control

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Natural persons who hold banking relationships with FirstUK Bank and whose personal data is subject to processing under this policy. Customers retain control over their personal data and must be informed of processing activities.
context: FirstUK Bank processes customer personal data
with proper safeguards and customer control
